_readme: Debug-build notes for this repository's release family. Not shared: a debug build's number belongs to one
family, so these stay out of the global changelog.json. Shown only by debug builds, newest first, for builds
newer than the last one the device saw. Add a line before publishing a debug build.

notes.text: Download diagnostics, the notification permission, and offline playback groundwork.
The download engine rebuilt: one queue for the device, profile views, device settings.
Automatic / Assisted / Manual download flows and the new Downloads screen. Logs file sizes for calibration.
Setup asks about downloads; Settings → Downloads rebuilt; this screen now comes from the changelog.
Downloads no longer hang on a dead connection or throw away a partial file; season progress counts the whole season.
Seasons in Assisted find their sources in the background and tell you when to choose a quality; a long pause keeps the partial file when its link expires.
iPhone no longer stays on the loading screen after choosing a profile; paused downloads keep their Android notification with a Resume button.
Assisted seasons can be given a quality with Choose now while sources are still being found, from clearly labelled size estimates.

After Choose now the season stays on the Downloads screen and in the Live Activity while its sources are checked; the Library and Downloads tabs no longer shift. iPhone transfers are the same as 56 (baseline for the comparison builds).

Download sizes are recalibrated from real files: Small, Standard (recommended), Large, Huge and Any, each showing its GB per hour at 1080p and 4K. iPhone hands up to 30 downloads to the system instead of 12, so a long season keeps going while locked; past 30, a note explains that the rest start when Nuvio is next opened.

The setup wizard is simpler to read: sizes are a list with GB per hour at 1080p and 4K (Standard recommended), playback quality limits have names, Assisted is the recommended Download Mode, and the Sources step says what is already set up. On a short phone the picture at the top shrinks so the choices fit. "Choose now" now says it uses size estimates.

Downloads has a new library: titles on this device are backdrop cards with their logo, what's next and a play button. A show's page has the title's details, Resume, seasons as tabs and compact episode rows with stills, descriptions and watched marks; a season's watched episodes can be deleted in one go. Title details are saved for offline use.

A downloaded show's page now says it is the copy on this device, with a Downloaded badge and an On this device summary. Desktop: with nothing downloading, Downloads shows your library as a grid; while downloads run, the library sits beside them as banners. Desktop downloads no longer stop and retry every 60 seconds on debrid sources.

Finished downloads are sorted into Title / Season folders, and existing ones move there on first launch; the Downloaded chip on a show's page is gone. Fixes from the final review: a profile switch during a background season no longer touches another profile's downloads or loses an early Choose now; offline autoplay stops at the end of what is downloaded; a file that vanished just before playing no longer falls back to online sources.

Watch Together on iPhone: the lock screen, Control Center and headset buttons now go through the party, so a pause or seek there reaches everyone (or is refused if the host controls playback) instead of only moving your own player. Unlocking no longer restarts a film you had paused, and a guest coming back waits to be put back in sync rather than playing from where it stopped. iPhone now tells the party when its player is actually buffering.

Setup + settings pass: Advanced Setup (Settings → Setup & about, the Done page, the What's New card), a reorganised Settings with Navigation and About pages, Welcome back / Device Setup when a profile arrives from desktop, and sync and sign-out fixes.

Rebuild of 66 whose notes left out that this is the first debug build on the upstream sync (vanilla 0.5.4-beta plus the UX convergence): upstream's floating navigation bar (adaptive, expanded, compact or classic, with glow on Android 13+) carrying Social and Z's tabs, new player controls with the legacy layout still an option, refreshed pop-ups and menus, skip movie credits, your subtitle choice carried to the next episode, a smoother Home banner, shimmering source-list labels, TMDB details on by default, and an expired sign-in no longer signing you out. Everything in 66 is here too.

Advanced Setup polish from the device pass: the Player, Touch, Home, Detail page, Enhanced metadata and Source list previews now show the app's real screens and fit a small phone; Touch and Navigation previews can be tried; subtitles preview the way this device's player draws them; Set up in Settings opens the page over Advanced Setup and Back returns to where you were; Social switches respond at once; a clearer Take the full tour; the tour no longer slides the whole screen. Welcome back on a phone now also sets up this phone's navigation and player.

TMDB details work again: builds now carry Nuvio's built-in TMDB key, so cast, artwork, episode details and More like this come from TMDB with no key of your own (68 shipped without one). Advanced Setup's player previews now show a real episode frame instead of the show's artwork, and never switch to it after a slow load.

iOS: fixes the confirmed app freeze caused by download progress and Live Activity updates, and makes player exit safe during subtitle loading. Failed or opening playback no longer starts an unrelated next-episode source picker; manual source errors remain actionable. Retest Classic playback while downloads run, repeated exit/reopen, subtitle switching, and the Live Activity's background message when locking the phone.

Classic playback: removes the incorrect 'No safe automatic source' toast while your manually chosen source opens. The source list now stops its automatic-selection watchdog after handing playback to the player. Debug 72's download freeze and lock-screen Live Activity fixes remain included.

Watch Together: returning from Away now catches up and proves player readiness before the host resumes, using the existing short recovery settle. Keeps the iOS socket recovery fixes and adds host hold diagnostics for the remaining lock retest.

Sign-in, sign-out and account switching reworked so an old or failed attempt can't override a newer one; profile selection after sign-in fixed. Keeps the iOS Watch Together recovery and the Downloads deadlock fix.

What's New is now one changelog across Desktop, Android and iPhone. This build previews the next release's notes: they open once after this update, and stay in Settings → What's New, which shows a New badge while something is unseen. Entries for other devices sit at the end of each update. Everything in 75 is here too.

Release candidate for 0.5.4-z2. Automatic playback never falls back to a source your debrid service has not cached yet (test Lioness S1E1 in Streamlined or Instant), and What's new is back in Settings under Setup & about.

Social V2 on top of 0.5.4-z2: Watching Now as backdrop cards with a join sheet, Recently watched as a per-friend timeline of stacked stills, Friends / Inbox / profile sheet, and an unread dot on Social. Sent requests, per-friend switches and the stored inbox stay hidden until the Social V2 backend is deployed.

Social settings now open from a gear in the Social tab (privacy, who can join you as quick choices, and a new Show friends on Home switch that syncs per profile); on big tablets in landscape Inbox and settings open as a side panel. Settings -> Downloads now looks and works like the other Settings pages. Everything in 85 is here too.

The Social server update is live, so sent requests, the stored inbox, recommendations and the per-friend Hide / Notify switches now appear. On the Home friends shelf, the "3h ago" label sits on a small dark chip so it reads on bright pictures. Everything in 86 is here too.

Party invites now say Sent, with an x to take one back; an invite that is ignored just stays Sent, and one that is declined says Declined (you can invite that friend again after 5 minutes). If someone turns down your request to join, you are told, even while you are watching something. Recently watched shows the show's name and picture instead of an episode's, and reads "Latest S5 E7 · 38 watched". The request-to-join card at the top of the screen now shows who you asked, the time left and Cancel, instead of just a picture. Everything in 87 is here too.
Check for updates always picks the newest debug build, whatever order GitHub lists them in.
When a friend you get notified about starts watching, the player tells you for a few seconds.
Friend requests, party invites, join requests and friends starting to watch now pop up as small banners at the top of the app. Tap one to open it, swipe it up to dismiss.
Nuvio Z keeps itself signed: renews on its own, updates from the banner, and Settings › Keep Nuvio Z working. iPhone setup and repair now go through the new installer.
Update test: installs from the banner over 92, and shows as Important. Install and Repair sit side by side in the installer.
Renewing and updating stay on the sign-in server that set this iPhone up, so Apple stops asking for a code. If Apple does ask during an update, the banner shows where to type it.
Keep Nuvio Z working tidied up: readable, plain settings rows, and Apple's code opens in a dialog.

Social V2, rebuilt on top of 0.5.4-z3 and the new iPhone installer (92-95 were installer builds without the Social work). Everything from 85-91 is here: the new Social tab, the gear for Social settings, per-friend Hide / Notify, invites that say Sent / Declined, and banners at the top of the app when a friend starts watching or sends you something.

Watch Together: a guest who goes back to the lobby now shows as In lobby and gets a Rejoin button. The info button on the Friends shelf matches Continue watching's. Watching Now no longer shuffles when several friends are watching. (Started-watching notifications for a new title, and not telling party members about each other, are fixed on the server for every build.)

The Watching Now sheet leads with the title's art: who, what and the episode on the picture, Join and Details side by side. Social notices in the player are now the same card as the banners at the top of the app: picture, face and title, with Accept and Decline on it. Swipe a card up to dismiss it.

Android: Social system notifications - friend requests, party invites, join requests, friends accepting, recommendations and friends you follow starting to watch - when Nuvio is closed or in the background (they start working once the server side is switched on). Both phones: Settings > Social > Notifications to choose what shows. iPhone: the Social tab shows how many unread items you have.

Recommendations: on a title's page, tap the three dots, then Recommend, pick friends and add a message. What friends recommend to you shows in the Social tab under Recommended to you (hold a card to remove it), and on the title's page. When someone starts a title you recommended, you are told.
Social stays live when Nuvio sits idle for more than an hour: pop-ups and banners used to stop until you brought the window back, because the live connection's sign-in ran out and was never renewed.
Avatar initials and the Inbox count sit in the middle of their circles again, and the details page's "Recommended to you by" line is visible (it was black on black).
"Recommended to you" moved to the top of the Inbox and left the Social feed. New: Social settings -> Home -> Show recommendations on Home adds them as a shelf on Home, under Friends.
The Inbox is split into Unread and Read, and something that arrives while it's open now lands under Unread (an invite that had just come in used to show up under Earlier).
Behind the scenes: the Social screens' text now comes from the app's string files, ready for translation. Nothing should look different; tell us if any Social label reads oddly.

Inviting friends to Watch Together now opens a picker - in the lobby and in the player: search, friends who are watching right now first, tick several and invite them in one go. Sent invites still have their cancel cross. Also: Android notifications no longer wait for you to open Social after the app starts (they were being dropped until Social finished loading), and an invite no longer shows twice (the old bottom prompt is gone).
